caption: The drawing shows a single, dark brown object positioned centrally against a plain, light beige background. The object resembles an old-fashioned metal oil lamp, featuring a shallow, rounded basin with a small spout protruding from its front right side. Extending upward from the back of the basin is a vertical slender rod, which is slightly bent and has a hook at the top. Attached to the midsection of the rod is a flat, rounded plate with a scalloped edge. The overall composition is minimal with the solitary object rendered in detail and the background kept empty and untextured.
title: Oil Lamp
